validUntilNote: Repository re-review date for this snapshot. Not an official DDPM expiry.
licenseNote: No license text was published on the MapServer layer metadata retrieved with this snapshot.

heightField.name: Height
heightField.note: Retained raw from the service. Do not read it as inundation depth, runup, a vertical datum, or a safety clearance.

riskField.name: Risk
riskField.note: The layer renderer labels these integers only as the digits 1–4. No legend text was published. Do not translate a code into depth, probability, or a safety class.

countFields.note: Some values are null. No census date is stated on the layer. Not shown on the map and not a current population.

projectedFields.note: Source numbers in an undocumented projected system. Map position uses the service point in EPSG:4326, which matches X_Long and Y_Lat. X and Y are not longitude or latitude.

featureServerNote: https://gis-portal.disaster.go.th/arcgis/rest/services/DDPM_RISK_TSUNAMI_Merge/FeatureServer/57 advertised Query,Create,Update,Delete,Uploads,Editing when checked on 2026-10-28. This snapshot was read from MapServer only and the application does not query either service at runtime.
limits: Authority-listed village points for Phang Nga. Not an inundation extent, evacuation route, refuge, coverage area, or live warning.
